# Remittances & Reconciliation

This folder is derived from [billing-accounts-finance.md](../../../billing-accounts-finance.md) and represents a menu or nested menu item. Each non-README Markdown file represents one permanent table workspace tab.

## Tabs

| Tab | Section slug | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| [Claim Reconciliation](claim-reconciliation.md) | `claim-reconciliation` | Coordinates claim reconciliation as an exception-driven worklist. |
| [Insurer Payments](insurer-payments.md) | `insurer-payments` | Manages the end-to-end insurer payments workflow for Remittances & Reconciliation. |
| [Payer Balances](payer-balances.md) | `payer-balances` | Provides a read-oriented payer balances table for analysis, reconciliation, drill-down, printing, and export without duplicating the authoritative source transactions. |

## Implementation contract

- Run the [reuse audit](../../_shared/existing-implementation.md) first; most of this scope already exists.
- Every listed workspace tab is an `AppListTable` worklist or tabular report.
- Forms and workflow actions open from toolbar/row buttons in dialogs.
- Permissions, entitlement, ABAC, human-friendly IDs, export/print, audit, and targeted refresh are mandatory.
- Use the [shared finance contracts](../../_shared/README.md) for tables, dialogs, permissions, API behavior, state, and audit.
